name: Syama Sastri
contribution: A musician and composer of Carnatic music.

checks.lead: Syama Sastri (Tamil: ஷ்யாமா சாஸ்திரி; IAST: Śyāma Śāstri; 26 April 1762 – 1827) or Shyama Shastri was a musician and composer of Carnatic music. He was the eldest among the so-called Trinity of Carnatic music, Tyagaraja and Muthuswami Dikshitar being the other two.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
